name: Los Angeles County (Unincorporated)
disclaimer: Applies only to unincorporated LA County areas. Most of the population lives in incorporated cities with their own codes. Verify with LA County Department of Regional Planning.

notes: LA County adopted an ADU ordinance aligning with state law.
Hillside and Very High Fire Hazard Severity Zones have additional construction requirements.
Grading on slopes may require geotechnical report.

fire.vhfhsz_note: Large portions of unincorporated LA County are in VHFHSZ. Verify at CAL FIRE or LA County Fire.

citations.vhfhsz: CA Gov Code §51177; LA County Fire Dept VHFHSZ maps
